definitions.gloss: command, order, signal, word of command
definitions.explanation: A verbal command or signal given to a group to coordinate action. Commonly used in military drills, school assemblies, sports, and other organized group activities.

examples.japanese: {号令|ごうれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{号令|ごうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと、{全社|ぜんしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Reforms were carried out company-wide under the president's orders.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {号令|ごうれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (give a command)
- {号令|ごうれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ (follow a command)
- {号令|ごうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと (under the command of)
- {号令|ごうれい}{一下|いっか} (at a single command)

USAGE:
Most Japanese people associate {号令|ごうれい} with school life — the class monitor (⟦{日直|にっちょく}→日直：14927_nicchoku⟧) calls out commands like 「{起立|きりつ}！⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧！⟦{着席|ちゃくせき}→着席：18472_chakuseki⟧！」 (Stand! Bow! Sit!) at the start and end of each class. The word is also used in business to describe orders from leadership that set company-wide action in motion.
